channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Candace Parker | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Candace Parker from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Damian Lillard on Candace Parker, Maya Moore, Diana Taurasi, Odyssey Sims
item.description:
Damian Lillard:

“My favorite is probably Candace Parker—that's my homegirl. Maya Moore. Diana Taurasi. But my sleeper, that I like personally, that I watch, Odyssey Sims. I've watched her since Baylor. She was nice there. I think that I've followed her for awhile, that I like her game a lot.”

Damian Lillard on Candace Parker, Maya Moore, Diana Taurasi, Odyssey Sims, Sep 26, 2018. Source: CBS News.

item.title: Shelden Williams on Candace Parker
item.description:
“I try to match the leggings with her Nike shirt. But when in doubt, I fall back on a white T-shirt and jeans. Candace doesn't like that.”

Shelden Williams on Candace Parker, Jun 16, 2012. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Shelden Williams on Candace Parker
item.description:
In 2009, her mother became the first pregnant woman to appear on the cover of ESPN The Magazine.

“Lailaa loves to perform when we go to my game or Candace's game, and she starts dancing and everyone starts paying attention to her,”

Shelden Williams on Candace Parker, Jun 16, 2012. Source: ESPN.com.
